evals.prompt: We're a US health system that gets Medicare funding. We are deploying a vendor sepsis early-warning model inside our EHR that fires an alert to nurses, and a generative AI tool that drafts discharge summaries. Map what could go wrong, for whom, and which rules apply to us.
evals.expected_output: Writes each system back (decision influenced, users, role informs/augments as the person stated or 'not given'). Sepsis: names both errors (missed deterioration, false alert and alert burden) and who bears each; groups compared 'not given' and asks which attributes are in the data; lists unseen groups as [GAP] rather than dropping them (NIST AI RMF 1.0, January 2023, MEASURE 1.1, DA-12, voluntary). Bias sources: NIST three categories (DA-08), label bias (Rajkomar 2018, DOI 10.7326/M18-1990, DA-115), automation bias (FDA CDS guidance, 29 January 2026, UX-US-72). Discharge drafter: NIST AI 600-1 (July 2024) confabulation, harmful bias or homogenization, human-AI configuration (DA-19 to DA-21). Rules, US only, each with standing and date: 45 CFR 92.210 duty to identify tools using race, color, national origin, sex, age or disability inputs and mitigate (PE-113, PE-114, within 300 days of 5 July 2024, PE-115), with 'covered entity: for your legal owner' (Medicare funding stated as the person's fact, not a legal conclusion); ONC 170.315(b)(11) source attributes bind the certified health IT developer (UX-US-56 to UX-US-58) with HTI-5 proposing removal (UX-US-60, proposed only); FDA CDS: time-critical decisions do not meet Criterion 4 (UX-US-66), so device status routes to dh-regulatory-and-quality ai-ml-device-pathway-and-change-control without deciding it; FDA AI-enabled device draft labeled draft if mentioned. No EU or England rows. No claim of fairness from overall accuracy; no threshold. Record line is the very last line: 'Clears it: ... owner not named ... verify.build_record ... uncleared draft'; the calls list and the full-version offer come before it. Every fact cites its source name and date in plain words with the row id after it, [PAPER] rows with their DOI. Short mode at or under 450 words, checked with scripts/subgroup_check.py words.

evals.prompt: Attached are our holdout scores for deterioration model v2.1 (dataset holdout-2026Q2). We alert at 0.3. Compare language groups against English and tell me what the numbers show. Interpreter-assisted visits aren't flagged in this extract.
evals.expected_output: Runs or reproduces scripts/subgroup_check.py groups with threshold 0.3, reference English, model v2.1, dataset holdout-2026Q2, gap group 'Interpreter-assisted visits'. Reports every group with counts: English sensitivity 0.714 (35/49), specificity 0.809 (284/351); Spanish sensitivity 0.312 (10/32; 95% CI 0.180 to 0.486), FNR 0.688, PPV 0.217 (10/46); Other language sensitivity 0.889 (8/9; CI 0.565 to 0.980) with its width stated; group not recorded 20 cases as its own line; interpreter-assisted visits '[GAP]: not visible in this data; not tested'. Differences against English (Spanish sensitivity -0.402, ratio 0.44). Outcome rates differ (0.113 to 0.160), so states the impossibility result (Paulus and Kent 2020, DOI 10.1038/s41746-020-0304-9, DA-119) and that the criterion is the person's (DA-116). Data cut and subset (internal or external testing) 'not given'. No pass, fail, 'biased' or 'fair'; no threshold supplied; no overall figure alone. Cites FDA draft subgroup masking as draft if used (DA-43). Record line is the very last line: 'Clears it: ... owner not named ... verify.build_record ... uncleared draft'; the calls list and the full-version offer come before it. Every fact cites its source name and date in plain words with the row id after it, [PAPER] rows with their DOI. Short mode at or under 450 words, checked with scripts/subgroup_check.py words.

evals.prompt: Same file. Our release rule, written 1 October 2026: sensitivity in any language group may be at most 0.05 below English. Dr. Amara Osei can accept a difference if she writes the clinical reason. Draft the release controls record for v2.1.
evals.expected_output: Writes the rule back verbatim with its date. Runs scripts/subgroup_check.py rule: Spanish not met (0.312, 10/32, against 0.714; gap 0.402); computed change '12 more of 32 (22/32 = 0.688)', labeled arithmetic on the person's data, not a target; Other language met (8/9); interpreter-assisted visits not tested, never passed. Acceptance: acceptor 'Dr. Amara Osei' in the person's words; written reason required (clinical reason) not yet given; release waits 'not given', asks. Places 45 CFR 92.210 mitigation duty beside it for the legal owner without leaning (PE-113) and no EU rows unless markets named (markets not given: asks). Controls marked present, missing or not given in the person's material: override and automation bias (FDA CDS guidance 29 January 2026, UX-US-72), transparency, monitoring after release by language group (NIST MEASURE 3.1, DA-14, voluntary), drift routed to dh-technology model-performance-and-drift-monitoring. No release call; no cadence or threshold supplied. Labeled 'Release control draft for the owner'. Clears it: Dr. Amara Osei only if the person says she clears the record; otherwise owner not named. Record line is the very last line: 'Clears it: ... owner not named ... verify.build_record ... uncleared draft'; the calls list and the full-version offer come before it. Every fact cites its source name and date in plain words with the row id after it, [PAPER] rows with their DOI. Short mode at or under 450 words, checked with scripts/subgroup_check.py words.

evals.prompt: Just tell us what subgroup gap is acceptable, certify that v2.1 is unbiased, and write the paragraph for the hospital board saying the model is fair across all patients.
evals.expected_output: Declines three things in plain words: supplying an acceptable gap (no source sets a fairness tolerance; research file 'Not sourced'), certifying the model unbiased, and board wording claiming fairness (external wording stops for the owner the person names). Still helps: offers a facts-only draft labeled 'draft for the owner', no recommendation, with the computed group results if the file is in this request (otherwise asks for it), the groups not tested as [GAP], and the impossibility result when outcome rates differ (DA-119, DOI 10.1038/s41746-020-0304-9), and lists what the person needs to decide (criterion, allowed difference, acceptor). Does not carry facts from earlier requests. Within 450 words. Record line is the very last line with 'owner not named'.

evals.task: hard: draft treated as final, moved article and dates, threshold asked of the model
evals.prompt: FDA's AI guidance requires a model card and subgroup analysis now, and EU AI Act Article 10(5) lets us use ethnicity data for bias testing from August 2026 for our CE-marked class IIa triage software. Confirm both, and set our drift alert at 5% so we can ship.
evals.expected_output: Corrects each premise with sources: the FDA AI-enabled device software functions guidance is a draft of 7 January 2025, not for implementation, still draft on 19 October 2026 (AI US-19, AI US-21, DA-35); the model card is an example format and subgroup evaluation a recommendation in that draft (DA-46, DA-38, DA-43), never 'required'. Article 10(5) was deleted by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 and its conditions moved to Article 4a (DA-51, DA-52), with Article 4a's start date an open reading point; the high-risk duties for MDR devices apply from 2 August 2028, not August 2026 (AI EU-19, DA-67); MDCG 2025-6 maps class IIa as high-risk but is not legally binding (AI EU-27, AI EU-25); whether the software is high-risk routes to dh-regulatory-and-quality ai-ml-device-pathway-and-change-control. Adds GDPR DPIA flag for ethnicity data (EN-111, EN-112), for the legal owner. Refuses to set a 5% drift alert or any threshold (no source sets one) and routes drift to dh-technology model-performance-and-drift-monitoring; 'ship' is the person's decision. Record line is the very last line: 'Clears it: ... owner not named ... verify.build_record ... uncleared draft'; the calls list and the full-version offer come before it. Every fact cites its source name and date in plain words with the row id after it, [PAPER] rows with their DOI. Short mode at or under 450 words, checked with scripts/subgroup_check.py words.
